meta.name: Jarna Color System
meta.scope: Colour only. Layout, font, sizes, spacing, radii, navigation and icons stay as in v65.
meta.principle: White rests; petrol identifies; coral directs; ink informs; mint supports
precedence: 1. Latest written direction from Fadl (chat / top of README-ar.md)

status_legend.approved: Value and usage stated in Policy v1 or the component rules that accompany it
status_legend.inherited: Hex named in a directive (33 component rules, philosophy or CLAUDE.md) but not in Policy v1 roles; catalogued earlier in Jarna-Color-Tokens.json
status_legend.prior-reference: Only found in prior work outputs (Jarna-Color-Tokens.json, Screen-Color-Distribution.csv). Used for comparison; kept provisionally because no directive covers the need. Pending Fadl (see CONFLICTS C12)
status_legend.derived: Not in any source; computed by ui-designer to satisfy a rule. Pending Fadl approval (see CONFLICTS.md)

petrolPressed.source: CLAUDE.md approved constraints (petrol pressed); also Tokens.json

coralPressed.source: 8% ink state layer over coral; keeps ink text at 4.80:1. See CONFLICTS C9

secondary.source: Tokens.json primitives.secondary; named in component rules

borderSubtle.source: Tokens.json; named in component rule 'card on white'

error.source: Tokens.json; named in component rule 'delete and error'

errorSurface.source: Tokens.json; named in component rule 'delete and error'

cream.source: Policy v1: excluded from UI backgrounds by latest user direction. Not exported to CSS/Dart.

background.usage: Page background on every screen. No cream, gradient or texture.

surface.usage: Cards, sheets, search field, inner-page headers.

footer.usage: Bottom tab bar and fixed bottom areas.

brandHeader.usage: Home header fill only. Not inherited by inner pages.

onBrandHeader.usage: Text and icons on the home header (Jarna name, address).

innerHeaderTitle.usage: Title and back icon on white inner-page headers.

floatingBasket.usage: Body of the oval floating basket pill. Shape, size and position unchanged.

onFloatingBasket.usage: Item count text on the basket pill.

basketArrowSurface.usage: Arrow circle inside the basket pill.

basketArrowIcon.usage: Arrow glyph inside the coral circle (not white). See CONFLICTS C10

primaryAction.usage: Add, continue and confirm buttons: 'إضافة', 'اختر طريقة الدفع', 'إتمام الطلب'. One filled primary per decision area.
primaryAction.source: Policy v1 roles.primaryPurchaseAction; rules 'add button', 'cart primary buttons'

onPrimaryAction.usage: Label and icons on coral. Never white (2.65:1).

primaryActionPressed.usage: Pressed fill for coral buttons (equivalent to an 8% ink ripple). Label stays ink.
primaryActionPressed.source: Derived from rule 'press and loading'. Pending Fadl, CONFLICTS C9

link.usage: Secondary text actions: 'تغيير', 'إضافة المزيد من المقاضي', account and support links. No coral fill.
link.source: Policy v1 roles.linksAndSelection; rules 'secondary links', 'account and support'

linkPressed.usage: Pressed state of petrol links, icons and the basket pill.

selectionIndicator.usage: Selected-category underline, radio/check marks, selected-address border, focus ring.
selectionIndicator.source: Policy v1 roles.linksAndSelection; rules 'selected category', 'selected address', 'fields and focus'

selectionSurface.usage: Fill of a selected address or option, inside existing space only. Never the only selection cue (1.17:1 against white).

selectionLabel.usage: Name of a selected category or address stays ink. See CONFLICTS C5

tabActive.usage: Active bottom-tab icon and label, with the existing weight/shape cue.

offerIcon.usage: Existing percent icon (offers tab, coupons). Coral body, ink percent mark. Selection still shown by petrol label + weight.
offerIcon.source: Policy v1 roles.offerIcon; rules 'offers tab icon', 'coupons and offers'

onOfferIcon.usage: Percent glyph inside the coral offer icon.

offerBadge.usage: Existing real-offer badge only, with ink text. Never added without offer data.

price.usage: Prices and totals. Never coral (implies discount) or petrol (looks like an action).
price.source: Policy v1 roles.textAndPrice; rule 'price and total'

textSecondary.usage: Units, descriptions, placeholders, struck-through old price (only with a valid comparison).

iconNeutral.usage: Neutral icons (or ink where the current app uses a dark icon).

iconAction.usage: Secondary-action and selection icons, search magnifier. Not the + and − of the current quantity stepper (use onQuantityStepper); petrol symbols on white apply only to the pending rule-based alternative (AUD-C9).

quantityStepper.usage: Fill of the existing solid quantity stepper pill (v65 shape kept). Provisional until Fadl decides AUD-C9.
quantityStepper.source: v65 CATEGORY-02 shape + identity role; CONFLICTS AUD-C9

onQuantityStepper.usage: + and − symbols and the count on the quantity stepper (6.40:1). Provisional (AUD-C9).

supportivePanel.usage: Supporting panels: free-delivery panel, empty-state support area, existing space behind category images.

confirmedFreeDelivery.usage: Free-delivery text, and the completed bar once eligibility is real.
confirmedFreeDelivery.source: Policy v1 roles.confirmedFreeDelivery; rules 'free delivery before/after'

freeDeliveryProgress.usage: Progress segment before eligibility. Non-text contrast below 3:1, so the amount text is the carrier. See CONFLICTS C11

freeDeliveryTrack.usage: Light track behind the progress bar ('مسار فاتح' has no value in sources).

border.usage: Light neutral divider for white cards on white, only where needed. Decorative (1.30:1).

controlBorder.usage: Boundary that identifies a control on white: search fields on white pages and inputs (4.17:1). Exceptions: the home-header search on petrol has no border (HM-09, provisional, CONFLICTS CR-N1); the current quantity stepper is solid (quantityStepper) and gets this border only in the pending rule-based alternative (AUD-C9).

timelineDone.usage: Completed and current timeline steps, with mark and label.

error.usage: Delete and error text/icons, field error messages. Never a purchase button.

destructiveAction.usage: Confirm button inside the empty-cart confirmation dialog only.
destructiveAction.source: Prior reference Screen-Color-Distribution UI-22; directive rule 'delete and error' covers red for delete only

onDestructiveAction.usage: Label on the red destructive button (6.57:1).

warning.usage: Warning text and icon: price change, stock change, unknown submit result.

success.usage: Server-confirmed success message (order received, delivered). Not used for actions.
success.source: Prior reference only: Tokens.json; Screen-Color-Distribution UI-09/UI-20. See CONFLICTS C6

disabled.usage: Disabled button fill. Never stays coral when unavailable.

overlay.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

contrast.method: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance, flat colours, computed 2026-10-20 by ui-designer. Not a device test.

pairs.use: primary action label, offer badge, basket arrow
selected label / panel text on mint
field error / delete link on white
card divider: decorative only, must not identify a control
mint selection fill: never the sole selection cue
coral button/offer-icon shape on white (non-text); label/glyph carries identity
coral arrow circle on petrol pill (non-text); ink arrow 5.47 carries meaning
